name: CID Realistic Comedy - 6x10s Vertical
description: Model-agnostic ComfyUI workflow specification for six 10-second realistic CID-style comedy clips.

generation.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, CGI look, deformed face, changing identity, changing uniform, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicate people, duplicate chicken, blood, gore, watermark, text overlay

notes: This is a portable specification, not a guaranteed drop-in workflow because ComfyUI node names differ by installed custom nodes/model version.
Install a compatible video model/custom-node package separately.
Use the same reference images and seed for character continuity when supported by the backend.
